purpose: Machine-checkable consumption of Product Lock v1.0.0 §6 (IP-safe direction and terminology policy) and Game Master Bible §1/§12. QA does not define vocabulary; AI-09 owns canon terms and AI-01 owns the policy. These rules only detect drift from the approved policy so a finding can be routed to the owner.

idPolicy.rule: Immutable once released. A rule is retired by setting status=RETIRED, never deleted.

DESIGN_DOC.description: Markdown planning/design documents. Rejected terms may legitimately appear when negated (e.g., 'not a Rubik simulator'). Matches here are reported as INFO for human review, never as failures.

IDENTIFIER.description: Stable IDs, event names, asset IDs, localization keys, JSON keys and enum values. Affirmative use is a failure because IDs are immutable once released.

PLAYER_FACING_STRING.description: Localized string values and UI copy. Not present in the repository until the LocalizationKey contract exists (Phase 01+). Scope is declared now so the rule set is complete; the validator reports SCOPE_EMPTY until files match.

rules.title: No proprietary franchise names as CraftCube vocabulary
rules.note: Design documents may mention these only to negate them. Any occurrence in an identifier, asset name, localization key or player-facing string is a defect. Matches align with AI-02's FORBIDDEN_KEY_TERMS list in 02_ARCHITECTURE/AI02_DOMAIN_CONCEPT_REGISTER_VALIDATOR.py so the two validators agree.

rules.title: Puzzle object is 'the cube', never a trademark or generic-competitor term
Player role is 'Weaver', not a generic hero/miner/crafter
rules.note: 'crafter' as a substring of 'CraftCube' is not matched because matchMode=phrase requires word boundaries.

rules.title: Solve consequence is 'restoration' / 'the world answers', never loot/drop/XP
rules.source: Product Lock §6.3 row 'Solve consequence'; CUT-003; CUT-006
rules.note: 'drop' is intentionally excluded: too many legitimate uses (frame drop, drop-down). Random-drop policy is enforced structurally by QAT-003 instead.

rules.title: No combat vocabulary in item/equipment definitions
rules.source: PD-002 'No damage, defense, health or attack categories exist'; CUT-005
rules.note: In IDENTIFIER scope only this is a hard failure. In DESIGN_DOC scope 'damage' has legitimate meanings (world damage, damaged cube) and is INFO.

rules.title: Assist feature is 'Smart Assist', never auto-solve/cheat
rules.note: Test names such as 'equipment_does_not_auto_solve' are expected and legitimate in QA-owned test code; QA test paths are excluded from IDENTIFIER scope by the validator's own-path exclusion.

rules.title: Generic mechanism names avoided for the Axis Loom
rules.note: INFO in design docs ('the core loop', 'protected core' are legitimate). FAIL only when used as an identifier or player-facing string naming the mechanism.

rules.title: Generic catastrophe names avoided for the Great Misalignment

approvedVocabularyReference.note: Copied from Product Lock §6.3 for cross-reference only. The Product Lock is authoritative; if this list drifts, the validator's product-doc cross-check reports it.
